overview: Naadani.in is a mobile-first baby products online store for Indian parents. Browse clothing, diapers, gear, and toys with INR pricing, add to cart, and place order inquiries. Includes an admin panel for product and order management.
features: Product catalog with 4 categories: Clothing, Diapers, Gear, Toys
Product detail pages with images and INR pricing
Shopping cart with quantity management and ₹ totals
Admin dashboard with login, product CRUD, and image uploads
Sample products pre-seeded across all categories
Mobile-first warm Indian design with soft pastels
